title: ShelfKit
description: A shelf of curated agent context: skills, prompts, instructions, agents, hooks, plugins, MCP servers, language servers, libraries, and stacks, composed into profiles. Find what fits a repository, read it, and plan the apm.yml that installs a profile. ShelfKit plans and never writes; you write the files, APM installs.

shelf.compile.plan.description: Plan the compile of one profile: the apm.yml to write, the vendored files, the install command, and the notes to pass on to the user. It changes nothing: ShelfKit plans, the agent writes the files, APM installs. Report the result with shelf.report.

shelf.item.get.description: Read one item: its item.json, its revision, and its files. Name it as `id` for the current revision, or `id@sha256-…` for a pinned one.

shelf.profile.get.description: Read one profile: what it declares, and its resolution, with bundles, extends, and requires expanded, each item's revision and origin, and the notices shelfkit check reports for it.

shelf.recommend.description: Recommend items and profiles for a repository from its stack markers: the files at its root, the package names in its dependency manifests, and its package manager. Stacks and libraries match on their markers, and a matched stack brings the items it recommends.

shelf.report.description: Record that a plan from shelf.compile.plan was applied to a repository: the profile and revision, the digest of the apm.yml written, and the outcome. This writes an activity record and nothing else. Returns whether the profile has moved on since.

shelf.search.description: Search one shelf's items by text over titles, descriptions, tags, and prompt bodies. Filter by kind and tag; with no query, list every item that passes the filters, such as every MCP server with kinds ["mcp"]. Returns summaries; read an item with shelf.item.get, which gives an MCP server's whole definition.
